Subsequently, and pursuant to the Antitrust Constitutional Amendment, on July 16, 2025, the Mexican Federal Antitrust Law ( Ley Federal de Competencia Económica ) was amended to incorporate the changes ordered therein as well as additional amendments. On October 16, 2025, the National Antitrust Commission ( Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio, or “ Antitrust Commission ”) was created as a decentralized authority sectorized to the Ministry of Economy ( Secretaría de Economía ), with operational and technical autonomy.
